test_title: RRB Group D 2025 (New Pattern) Official Mock Test
subject: general
question: AGPV is related to DISX in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, MOBD is related to PQEF. To which of the options is VUKJ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

** AGPV → DISX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b509a5648a36a96c01f84079a338df586d6833d7ea78472e20a431ceca07f50.png] 

**MOBD → PQEF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edb38a0d85682213a8bc329491407011f2a7c72e9439d4843c1e4f5389c8da66.png] 

Applying the Pattern to VUKJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08ae3e067bd5adb25b73decf2e1207dc5c2b37c6779ae3f172bf0cf9919ba265.png] 

Thus, the letter-cluster related to VUKJ is **YWNL**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
